title: Governed source artifact structural coherence
statement: Governed source artifacts to which a registered profile applies MUST have one authoritative responsibility, one resolvable permitted archetype, and profile-coherent structural composition.
rationale: File-level cohesion is meaningful only when authored responsibility and observed language-native composition remain distinct, traceable, and reconciled without universal syntax rules.
failure_prevented: Undocumented source responsibility, ambiguous file roles, forbidden stateful implementation in interface-only artifacts, hidden generated provenance, and unsupported analysis reported as absence.
applicability: Every governed Code artifact; archetype composition is applicable only where a validated Source Profile is registered for its language.
evaluation: Source Architecture composes Project Filing ownership, canonical code_docs.md responsibility, adapter observations, and stable semantic references into Source Artifact Model v1 and evaluates only profile-declared structural composition.

finding.message: A governed source artifact lacks authoritative responsibility or violates an applicable profile's archetype and semantic-region composition.

remediation: Document the file's single architectural responsibility in canonical code_docs.md, register or correct the applicable language profile, and align observed composition with exactly one permitted archetype without suppressing unsupported coverage.
valid_example: A functional module has one documented responsibility and a profile-permitted group of related declarations without any universal one-function-per-file constraint.
invalid_example: An interface-only archetype contains profile-forbidden mutable implementation, or generated source has no generator provenance.
exception_policy: No language-independent ordering or one-X-per-file exemption exists because those are not universal rules; profile absence remains explicitly not applicable until that language profile is delivered.
history: Introduced with deterministic Source Artifact Model v1.
